You crush a pinch of frost and cast it upward. A curtain of whirling snow closes across the battlefield.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Target / range / shape
One connected area of visible ground squares within 6 squares.
Limits
Maintain one whiteout at a time.
Type
Magic / Control

Make a Knowledge roll. Place heavy-cover snow in up to 5/8/12 connected ground squares on Weak/Standard/Strong, all within 6 squares. It lasts until the end of your next turn. On later turns, you may spend a Maneuver to sustain it until the end of your next turn.
